description.content:
获取事件定义列表
```
  curl -X POST 'http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/schema/event/list' \
    -H 'Accept: application/json' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H 'api-key: {apiKey}' \
    -H 'sensorsdata-project: {projectName}' \
    -d '{"expand": "custom_params","page_size": 1
    }'
  返回值示例:
  {
      "code": "SUCCESS",
      "request_id": "111439553289fbce04c278b6db07656c",
      "data": {
          "schemas": [

                  "project_id": 1,
                  "name": "events.ViewProduct",
                  "display_name": "ViewProduct",
                  "type": "LOGICAL",
                  "schema_class": "EVENT",
                  "schema_display_type": "BASIC",
                  "original_name": "ViewProduct",
                  "builtin": false,
                  "has_data": true,
                  "visible": true,
                  "enable": true,
                  "custom_params": {
```
